finalText:
Build's clean. The two real bugs were buried in the deprecation warnings from the package bump.

First one: `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler changed it to hand `options.retryCount`. Changed it to use the new shape.

Second one: `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Added a check to treat `undefined` as the default `false`.

The 8 remaining warnings are just deprecations from the dependency bump — no code issues.
